newsitem.title: USA: PremiumWear posts Q4 profit vs loss.
newsitem.headline: PremiumWear posts Q4 profit vs loss.

text.p: PremiumWear Inc said Thursday an increase in interest income based on the sale of trademarks helped the company report a profit in the fourth quarter.
The company said net income reached $69,000, or $0.03 a share, in the period ended January 4, compared to a loss of $2.3 million, or $1.13 a share one year ago.

PremiumWear said total revenues of $7.0 million were down from $11.9 million mostly because of the sale of its retail and golf-oriented businesses. The company said those units contributed $9.2 million to revenues one year ago.
PremiumWear markets Munsingwear brand knit shirts and other apparel.
Its shares were trading down 3/8 Thursday at 8-3/4.
